item.title: Building a Local BIM-MEP Planning Tool
item.description:
My broader renovation approach covers things like decisions, costs, companies, documents, and generally trying to keep the renovation organised.

While working on that, I kept coming back to a different problem.

Once the house is finished, a lot of the important technical work will disappear. Cables will be inside walls, pipes under floors, ducts above ceilings, sensors mounted in places I will eventually forget about. Photos help, drawings help, but I wanted something I could actually inspect and search later.

item.title: Building a Private Home-Server Infrastructure
item.description:
I recently bought a mini-PC to use as a home server.

I have been wanting to move more of the software I use regularly onto my own hardware, but until now most of my self-hosting work has been made up of separate experiments. With this machine I want to put those services in one place and maintain them as part of the same system.

The server will run Debian and will only be remotely accessible through a VPN. Larger files and application data will be stored on directly attached storage, with separate encrypted backups.
